notes.title: BALANCING UPDATE 🦆🛠
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107244/778b2fb3f726c924b599d8a7b40dc362f3d39aa3.jpg[/img]

After lots of hard work and amazing feedback from our players, we've made updates to improve the demo and create a smoother, more seamless experience! 🛠
Check out the changes and fixes below:

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Rebalanced Duck Power[/b] – as all things should be! 🦆💥
[*] [b]Increased gameplay difficulty[/b] toward the end for a greater challenge. 📈
[*] [b]Chickens are now bulkier.[/b] 💪🏼🐔
[*] Elite Chickens spawn more frequently. 🐔📈
[*] Adjusted the XP bar for higher levels, making it tougher to level up. 🔵
[*] Reworked the economy—more fortune to heist! 💰💎
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45107244/0aa3c7f2ac0e1e2b0eb808d28dbf0c630dc8dabd.gif[/img]

If you have any question or thoughts, feel free to comment down below!

Sincerely,
[b]The Reima Project Team[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes - Jul 30 2024
notes.notes:
Hi Quackers!

We have addressed some bugs and improvements for this day one patch.
Here are the details :

[list]
[*] Pressing spacebar (Halt) will highlight the ducks on the map
[*] Better text detail for purchasing units, now any ducks you don't have will be shown as "New"
[*] Various text improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

Enjoy!
